resources.string:
"Thanks for trying out ActivityWatch for Android!" "It's not quite as matured as ActivityWatch on other platforms, but it's a great step in the right direction and we think it's ready enough to put out there!"
"

To get started, open the drawer menu in the top left and click on "Activity".
"

The next step for us is to get cross-device synchronization in place, but it might take a while since we really want to get it right."
"
If you're new to ActivityWatch, you should also check out the desktop version of ActivityWatch."
Allows ActivityWatch to read the URL and title from your browser.
Bind the ActivityWatch server on all interfaces so it is reachable over your tailnet (or other trusted network). When disabled, only this device can access the server.

Enabling remote access will bind the ActivityWatch server to all network interfaces, making it reachable from anything that can route to this device.

The ActivityWatch API has no authentication, so anyone who can reach the port will be able to read and modify your activity data.

Only enable this on a trusted network you control end-to-end (e.g. a tailnet). Do not enable on public Wi-Fi.
Restart the app for this change to take effect.
Bring the ActivityWatch server up automatically when the device finishes booting and is unlocked. Disable if you prefer to open the app manually.
Persistent notification shown while the local ActivityWatch server is running.
